# @boostengine/core — Full API Manifest (v1.1.0)

`@boostengine/core` is the central kernel of the BoostEngine ecosystem. All 23
`@boostengine/*` packages depend on its primitives. This manifest documents the
complete public surface for coding agents, MCP servers, and integrators.

---

## 1. Action & Filter Hook System

WordPress/Shopify-style hooks. Lower `priority` numbers run first. Callbacks may
be synchronous or asynchronous; `doAction` and `applyFilters` await each one.

```ts
type ActionCallback = (...args: any[]) => Promise<void> | void;
type FilterCallback<T = any> = (value: T, ...args: any[]) => Promise<T> | T;

interface HookSystem {
  addAction(tag: string, callback: ActionCallback, priority?: number): void;
  doAction(tag: string, ...args: any[]): Promise<void>;
  removeAction(tag: string, callback?: ActionCallback): boolean;
  hasAction(tag: string, callback?: ActionCallback): boolean;
  removeAllActions(tag?: string): void;
  addFilter<T = any>(tag: string, callback: FilterCallback<T>, priority?: number): void;
  applyFilters<T = any>(tag: string, value: T, ...args: any[]): Promise<T>;
  removeFilter(tag: string, callback?: FilterCallback): boolean;
  hasFilter(tag: string, callback?: FilterCallback): boolean;
  removeAllFilters(tag?: string): void;
  removeAllHooks(tag?: string): void;
  clear(): void;
  listActionTags(): string[];
  listFilterTags(): string[];
  getActions(tag?: string): Array<{ tag: string; callback: ActionCallback; priority: number }>;
  getFilters(tag?: string): Array<{ tag: string; callback: FilterCallback; priority: number }>;
}
```

Exports: `class BoostHookSystem`, `createHooks()`, plus standalone global
functions `addAction`, `doAction`, `addFilter`, `applyFilters`, `removeAction`,
`removeFilter`, `hasAction`, `hasFilter`, `removeAllHooks`, `getDefaultHooks`.

```ts
import { createHooks } from '@boostengine/core';
const hooks = createHooks();
hooks.addFilter('cart.total', (total, cart) => (cart.vip ? total - 100 : total), 10);
const total = await hooks.applyFilters('cart.total', 500, { vip: true }); // 400
```

---

## 2. Event Bus & Lifecycle Management

```ts
interface EventEnvelope<T = any> {
  id: string; topic: string; payload: T; timestamp: number; expiresAt?: number;
}

interface EventBus {
  on(pattern: string, listener: EventListener): () => void;
  once(pattern: string, listener: EventListener): () => void;
  off(pattern: string, listener?: EventListener): void;
  emit<T>(topic: string, payload?: T, options?: { ttl?: number }): Promise<void>;
  emitSync<T>(topic: string, payload?: T, options?: { ttl?: number }): void;
  replay(pattern?: string): EventEnvelope[];
  listenerCount(pattern?: string): number;
  topics(): string[];
  clear(): void;
}
```

Exports: `createEventBus(options?)`, `EventBusImpl`, `matchesPattern(topic, pattern)`.

Wildcard semantics (dot-delimited): `*` matches one segment, `**` matches zero or
more segments, a bare `*` matches everything. `options.defaultTtl` applies a
default TTL (ms); `replay` hides expired events. `options.historyLimit` bounds
the replay history.

### Domain Events

```ts
DOMAIN_EVENTS.AUTH.LOGIN            // 'auth.login'
DOMAIN_EVENTS.CART.UPDATED          // 'cart.updated'
DOMAIN_EVENTS.CHECKOUT.STARTED      // 'checkout.started'
DOMAIN_EVENTS.PAYMENT.SUCCESS       // 'payment.success'
DOMAIN_EVENTS.ORDER.CREATED         // 'order.created'
DOMAIN_EVENTS.INVENTORY.STOCK_LOW   // 'inventory.stock_low'
DOMAIN_EVENTS.SHIPPING.DISPATCHED   // 'shipping.dispatched'
// ...plus LOGOUT/REGISTERED/PASSWORD_RESET, ITEM_ADDED/ITEM_REMOVED/CLEARED,
// ABANDONED/COMPLETED, INITIATED/FAILED/REFUNDED, UPDATED/CONFIRMED/SHIPPED/
// DELIVERED/CANCELLED, UPDATED/OUT_OF_STOCK, RATE_CALCULATED/LABEL_CREATED/
// DELIVERED.
```

Also exported: `DOMAIN_NAMESPACES`, `DomainNamespace`.


---

## 3. Modular Plugin Runtime

```ts
interface BoostPlugin {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  version: string;
  description?: string;
  icon?: string;
  category?: PluginCategory;
  defaultSettings?: Record<string, any>;
  dependencies?: string[];                       // must register first

  init?(context: PluginContext): Promise<void> | void;
  registerHooks?(engine: BoostEngine): Promise<void> | void;
  boot?(context?: PluginContext): Promise<void> | void;
  shutdown?(): Promise<void> | void;

  // Legacy aliases
  onInit?(context: PluginContext): Promise<void> | void;
  onActivate?(): Promise<void> | void;
  onDeactivate?(): Promise<void> | void;
  onOrderCreated?(order: Order, context: PluginContext): Promise<void> | void;
  onProductViewed?(product: any, context: PluginContext): Promise<void> | void;
  onCartUpdated?(cart: any, context: PluginContext): Promise<void> | void;
}

interface BoostEngine {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly config: BoostEngineConfig;
  readonly hooks: HookSystem;
  readonly events: EventBus;
  readonly store: Store<EngineState>;
  registerPlugin(plugin: BoostPlugin): Promise<RegisteredPlugin>;
  unregisterPlugin(id: string): Promise<void>;
  start(): Promise<void>;
  shutdown(): Promise<void>;
  getPlugin(id: string): RegisteredPlugin | undefined;
  getPlugins(): RegisteredPlugin[];
  enablePlugin(id: string): Promise<void>;
  disablePlugin(id: string): Promise<void>;
  isPluginHealthy(id: string): boolean;
  healthCheck(): PluginHealthReport[];
  inspect(): EngineInspection;
}
```

Exports: `createBoostEngine(config?)`, `BoostEngineImpl`, `registerPlugin`,
`getDefaultEngine`, plus legacy `BoostPluginEngine`, `boostCore`, `BOOST_HOOKS`.

`BoostEngineConfig` supports `id`, `storeId`, `debug`, `strictDependencies`
(default `true`), `autoStart`, `env`, and `plugins`.

### Lifecycle order

1. `start()` topologically sorts plugins by `dependencies`.
2. For each (dependency-first): `init(ctx)` -> `registerHooks(engine)`.
3. For each (dependency-first): `boot(ctx)`.
4. `shutdown()` runs `shutdown()` in reverse dependency order.

### Health checks

`healthCheck()` returns per-plugin `PluginHealthReport`:
`{ id, name, version, status, healthy, dependenciesSatisfied, missingDependencies, error }`.
A plugin is healthy when its dependencies resolve, it is enabled, and it is not
`failed` or `shutdown`.

---

## 4. Reactive Store

```ts
interface Store<T> {
  getState(): T;
  setState(update: Partial<T> | ((state: T) => Partial<T>)): void;
  subscribe(listener: (state: T, prev: T) => void): () => void;
  derive<D>(selector: (state: T) => D): Store<D>;
}
```

Exports: `createStore`, `getState`, `setState`, `subscribe`, `derive`.
`derive` memoises the selected value and only re-emits when it changes.

```ts
import { createStore, subscribe } from '@boostengine/core';
const store = createStore({ count: 0 });
const unsub = subscribe(store, (s) => console.log(s.count));
store.setState({ count: 1 });
unsub();
```

---

## 5. Currency & Money Engine

All arithmetic is integer-safe (computed in minor units), avoiding IEEE-754
drift. `Money.amount` is expressed in major units for ergonomics.

```ts
interface Money { amount: number; currency: CurrencyCode; }
```

Exports: `addMoney`, `subtractMoney`, `multiplyMoney`, `divideMoney`,
`negateMoney`, `compareMoney`, `isZeroMoney`, `assertSameCurrency`,
`convertMoney(m, targetCurrency, rate)` (`rate` = units of target per 1 source
unit), `formatMoney(m, options?)`, `toMinorUnits`, `fromMinorUnits`,
`getMinorUnits`, `CURRENCY_MINOR_UNITS`, `DEFAULT_MINOR_UNITS`.

Zero-decimal currencies (JPY, KRW, VND) use 0 minor units; BHD/KWD/OMR use 3;
all others default to 2.

```ts
import { addMoney, formatMoney } from '@boostengine/core';
const a = { amount: 0.1, currency: 'USD' };
const b = { amount: 0.2, currency: 'USD' };
addMoney(a, b); // { amount: 0.3, currency: 'USD' } — no 0.30000000000000004
formatMoney({ amount: 1299.5, currency: 'INR' }); // "₹1,299.50"
```

## 6. Shared Type Primitives

`CurrencyCode`, `Money`, `PriceBreakdown`, `Address`, `Customer`, `LineItem`,
`Order`, `PaymentSession`, `OrderStatus`, `PaymentStatus`, `PluginCategory`,
`PluginContext`. See `src/types/index.ts` for field-level detail.

## 7. AI Agent Toolkit (`@boostengine/core/ai`)

```ts
interface ToolDefinition {
  name: string;
  description: string;
  parameters: JsonSchema;
  execute?(args: Record<string, any>, context?: ToolContext): any | Promise<any>;
}
```

Exports: `coreTools: ToolDefinition[]`, `createCoreTools(engine?)`,
`toOpenAITools(tools)`, `toAnthropicTools(tools)`, `toMCPTools(tools)`,
`getCoreSystemPrompt()`, `generatePluginBoilerplate(args)`.

Core tools:
1. `inspect_engine_state` — plugins, hooks, event listeners, config.
2. `trigger_engine_event` — dispatch a synthetic event.
3. `evaluate_filter_pipeline` — run a value through a filter tag.
4. `generate_plugin_boilerplate` — scaffold a type-safe plugin.
